fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects when a system process (i.e. located in system32, syswow64, etc.) loads a DLL from a suspicious location or a location with permissive permissions such as "C:\Users\Public"
fields.name: DLL Load By System Process From Suspicious Locations
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "C:\\Windows\\" and (module.path contains "C:\\Users\\Public\\" or module.path contains "C:\\PerfLogs\\")))
